scope: Second scrolling group: single-child scrolling, grids, and animated lists (SingleChildScrollView, GridView with SliverGridDelegate, AnimatedList, AnimatedGrid, animated collection controller). Viewport clipping attaches unconditionally, so the removed per-view clip overrides are recorded in docs/API_MIGRATIONS.md, not here. Animated scroll positions stay internal; only structure controllers attach externally. Pages, sliver-only animated/reorderable lists, two-dimensional views, scrollbars, and physics internals belong to later groups. Single- versus multiple-viewport attachment stays a W5 gap. This ledger covers only this family; it does not claim whole-codebase completeness.
